title: RIMPAC 2018 Hosts Submarine Rescue Symposium
description: JOINT BASE PEARL HARBOR-HICKAM (July 9, 2018) – Approximately 30 submarine officers and civilian contractors from 13 nations attended a Rim of the Pacific (RIMPAC) 2018 submarine rescue symposium hosted at Joint Base Pearl Harbor-Hickam, July 9.
